# PERITONEAL DIALYSIS COLONOSCOPY PROPHYLAXIS

>Colonoscopy generally doesn't not require antimicrobial prophylaxis

>Patients who use peritoneal dialysis are at higher risk of bacterial

translocation during colonoscopy.

>Ensure that the abdomen is empty of fluid before procedures.

>Antimicrobials during procedure may be used, generally covering gram negatives

and anaerobes.

# Antimicrobial Prophylaxis

[Cefazolin 1 gm IV \(M\) once](psjizid-cefazolin-1-gm-iv-once-prophylaxis)

< OPTIONAL ADD ON TO ABOVE FOR ANAEROBIC COVERAGE>

[Metronidazole 500 mg IV DI once](psjizid-metronidazole-500mg-iv-once-preop)

< OR >

[Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV R once](psjizid-ampicillin-sulbactam-3gm-iv-once-preop)

< OR >

[Ampicillin 1 gm IV R once < AND > gentamicin 80 mg IV R,O once](orz-set-abx-ampicillin-1gm-iv-gentamicin-80mg-iv-once-preop)
